RawDataView.workspaceSubtitle: Select a component and analysis range.
RawDataView.forecastAccuracyInfoLine1: 1M compares the actual reading with the forecast prepared one month earlier.
RawDataView.forecastAccuracyInfoLine2: 3M, 6M and 12M use older forecast snapshots prepared respectively 3, 6 or 12 months before the target month.
RawDataView.forecastHorizonInfoBody: 1M compares the actual reading with the forecast that was made one month earlier. 3M and 6M use older forecast snapshots for that same target month.
